commit.message:
test(sequentialthinking): expect zod 4.6's type-array form for boolean|string unions

zod 4.6 writes a union of primitive types as `type: ["boolean", "string"]` rather than an anyOf of single-type schemas. The two are equivalent JSON Schema; published installs already resolve zod 4.6, so this only catches the lockfile up.
